name: sideview
description: The side view on macOS: a session on the left and Chrome (or Glass on the box) filling the rest, tiled through the accessibility API in one call, and put back on close.

tips.text: Type `side view` in the Capsule: your assistant on the left, Chrome filling the rest.
Run `vyre sideview` to put this terminal session on the left and Chrome beside it.
Type `close side view`, or run `vyre sideview close`, to put the windows back where they were.
The side view moves windows through Accessibility. If nothing moves, turn it on in System Settings.
Run `vyre sideview --ratio 0.4` to give the session more room. Any share from 0.2 to 0.5 works.
Run `vyre sideview --glass kit` to put kit's Glass beside your session instead of Chrome.
Type `side view` and a session's name to put that session on the left instead of your assistant.
Pick `Side view with this terminal` in the Capsule to tile the terminal in front beside Chrome.
